scope: Three assigned public collection-related forks under hsoliwal. Root owns the complete account repository inventory.
mode: read-only source donor audit; candidate-only reuse decisions

license.boundary: Retain source attribution and exception text. Do not assume compiler runtime-embedding relief applies to a Java source port.
Preserve applicable license and attribution; inspect relevant notices and generated-source provenance before adaptation.

source_tree_inventory.mode: two targeted source files; no whole recursive tree read

license.designation: Apache-2.0 for inspected Java headers; repository license also includes component-specific terms
license.boundary: Read applicable NOTICE and retain relevant source and component notices before importing code. Repository-wide license cannot be reduced to a blanket claim for all components.

source_facts.inspection: source read at exact commit; not compiled or executed
observed: 32-bit UInt32 occupancy representation for buckets.
Population count, trailing-zero first-member lookup, and clear-lowest-bit iteration.
Maps sparse bucket positions to packed slots through rank and supplies inverse bucket selection.
source_facts.m3_fit: Candidate primitive metadata atom for packed indexed storage.
limits: Swift unsigned-width and wrapping-shift semantics require Java/JNI edge qualification.
Internal rank/select dependencies were identified but not executed.

source_facts.inspection: source read at exact commit; not compiled or executed
observed: Separates physical buffer, starting slot, count and capacity.
Maps offsets using addition and conditional wraparound.
Exposes contiguous segments before and after the buffer boundary.
source_facts.m3_fit: Candidate array-offset and wrapped-copy patterns for Java/JNI deques.
limits: Arbitrary capacity is supported; replacing conditional wrap with a bit mask requires a separately proven power-of-two invariant.
Swift ownership, pointer access, wrapping arithmetic and element lifecycle need an actual port.
Swift source performance comments are not M3 benchmark evidence.

source_facts.inspection: source read at exact commit; not compiled or executed
observed: ManagedBuffer-backed Storage instances represent individual hash-tree nodes.
Separate item and child occupancy bitmaps determine packed item and child counts.
Allocates aligned storage with power-of-two allocation units; items and child references occupy separate buffer regions.
source_facts.m3_fit: Algorithm and layout donor requiring flattening into owned array lanes and integer links.
limits: Unchanged donor retains node objects; direct import does not satisfy the requested flattened indexed representation.
Key/value items are Swift inline tuples; Java object/array layout is materially different.
No claim of complete HAMT implementation or behavior equivalence.

source_facts.inspection: source read at exact commit; not compiled or executed
observed: Stores keys and values in parallel char[][] and V[] arrays without stored Map.Entry nodes.
Uses power-of-two capacities, capacity masks and odd-step collision probes.
Provides char-array offset/length lookup and CharSequence lookup.
Iterator.next() creates a transient API MapEntry containing a slot index.
Rehash redistributes parallel key/value lanes.
source_facts.m3_fit: Strong Java donor for a specialized char-slice map and matching set storage.
limits: Specialized contract excludes individual removal and shrinking.
put(char[]) retains the caller array and lowercases it in place when ignoreCase is enabled.
Not a drop-in general-purpose Map replacement.
Dependencies and exact modern source compatibility remain unqualified.

source_facts.inspection: source read at exact commit; not compiled or executed
observed: Stores fixed logical bit length in long[] with an explicit used-word count.
Uses word offsets, masks, population counts and trailing-zero scans.
orMask handles masks crossing a 64-bit word boundary.
Contains readNBits, orRange, andRange, intersection and union count operations.
source_facts.m3_fit: Strong Java donor for packed collection state and bulk bit-range atoms; JNI requires a separate port.
limits: Mask significant-bit limits, index ranges, unused tail bits, empty ranges and boundary crossings must remain explicit contracts.
Not dependency-free; inherit or isolate the required helper behavior.
No speedup, SIMD code generation, JNI equivalence or peak-performance claim was measured.

source_facts.inspection: source read at exact commit; not compiled or executed
observed: Registers Eclipse serializers, deserializers, value instantiators and type modification.
Registers pair/triple construction support and mixins.
source_facts.m3_fit: Candidate serialization integration for M3-owned Eclipse-compatible implementations.
limits: This is integration code, not an underlying collection storage kernel.
Branch is Jackson 3 with tools.jackson.* packages; it is not a Jackson 2 drop-in.
M3 type registration and compatibility require separately executed round-trip and configuration proofs.

source_facts.inspection: source read at exact commit; not compiled or executed
observed: Creates a backing multimap through createMultimap and inserts decoded values through multimap.put.
Supports contextual key/value deserializers and value type deserialization.
Contains array and optional single-value paths, null skipping/rejection policy, and final conversion to the target type.
source_facts.m3_fit: Candidate parser and serialization-contract donor after a real M3 multimap implementation exists.
limits: Underlying Guava Multimap storage is delegated to, not implemented by, this source.
Jackson 3 tools.jackson.* and Guava dependencies must be reconciled explicitly.
No parser behavior, error-path, aliasing or round-trip tests were run.

priority: Inspect and qualify isolated Lucene CharArrayMap character-slice and FixedBitSet range atoms against current M3 operations.
Port Swift bitmap and ring-offset atoms only where catalogue comparison identifies an uncovered advantage.
Use Jackson code for JSON integration after underlying M3 collection contracts exist.
qualification_limits: No clones, downloads, JVM runs, tests, benchmarks, generated implementations, new architecture or GitHub mutations occurred.
Read branch searches are observations, not an exhaustive branch inventory: Lucene returned a first page of 20 branch names.
Only the seven named source files were behaviorally inspected; complete recursive tree inventory is not full source review.
No donor is admitted as contract-equivalent, fastest, peak optimized, JNI-qualified or a completed five-library superset.
Candidate classifications must pass fit, attribution, differential behavior and appropriate performance gates before implementation.
